name: B47ANCE’d Provisions

features.text: Client-only apple/rack drying prechecks with localized failed/unknown states, bounded user-triggered scans and sandbox display toggle. Never starts drying or proves whole-item eligibility; native SP/dedicated not tested.
Read-only vanilla food/freshness/nutrition/preservation inspection, ingredient registry and optional inventory report.
Engine-independent preservation state machine and optional appliance water/power reservation coordinator; no native production process registered.
First candidate: one whole Apple at native small-plant drying racks, producing proposed dried-apple slices. Design and Build 42.21 API audit exist; production integration is not implemented.
Server hook/identity proof, food-state conservation, sandbox duration/snapshot binding, durable completion and unloaded/save/restart/join validation.

limits: Preview is local presentation only; native getter dispatch, rack variants and UI/controller behavior NOT TESTED. Whole-item integrity and server access remain UNKNOWN. Production G7 and stable G8 BLOCKED. Legacy foodWorks API/sandbox/save keys retained; no drying recipe/output/job registered. Existing coordinator legacy-provider compatibility remains unverified.

relations.text: Existing appliance reservation contract; legacy global and paired-build compatibility unverified. Fruit drying has no power dependency.
Existing appliance fluid reservation contract; no production process. Fruit drying has no water dependency.
